title: CAD, Scale Drawing & Spatial Design

standards.focus: Represent transformations in the plane using geometric and coordinate descriptions.
Given a geometric figure and a rotation, reflection, or translation, draw the transformed figure and specify the sequence.
Verify experimentally the properties of dilations and scale relationships.
Use geometric shapes, measures, and properties to describe and model objects.
Apply concepts of density and measurement to modeling situations.
Apply geometric methods to solve design problems.
evidence: u12-l01 through u12-l07 CAD design sequence

standards.focus: Use units as a way to understand problems and guide multi-step solutions.
Choose a level of accuracy appropriate to limitations on measurement.
evidence: u12-l02 tolerance, error, and significant figures
